strategy_roster.name: Price Statistical Z-Score
strategy_roster.notes: ZScoreBasePeriod 3 is the base z-score and the documented ShortSmoothPeriod 3 and LongSmoothPeriod 5 are the two smoothers; the long-only rule maps the short-above-long cross to entry and the reverse to exit. The three-bullish-candle filter and the GapBars 5 signal gap need shifted bars and are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Money Rain
strategy_roster.notes: The documented DeMarker 0.5 decision level is approximated by RSI with the documented DeMarkerPeriod 31, since DeMarker is not in the DSL. TakeProfitPoints 5 and StopLossPoints 20 are oscillator-style point offsets, not percentages, and the loss-limit and volume logic are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: ComFracti
strategy_roster.entry_long: low < donchian_low_prev(low,3) and low < donchian_low_prev(low,10) and rsi(close,3) < 50
strategy_roster.exit_long: high > donchian_high_prev(high,3) and high > donchian_high_prev(high,10) and rsi(close,3) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: Current- and higher-timeframe bullish fractals are approximated by new 3-bar and 10-bar lows and the documented RSI filter by RSI(3) on the 50 line. Stochastic levels, EMA slope, Parabolic SAR, channel and perceptron filters are unavailable, and the point-based stops are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Hurst Exponent Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Hurst is approximated by ADX strength, so the documented HurstThreshold 0.55 persistence test becomes an ADX band and the documented MaPeriod 20 is used verbatim. ADX 20/25 are fallbacks for HurstPeriod 100 and no numeric percentage stop is given despite the docs saying a percentage stop exists.

strategy_roster.name: UP3x1 Premium
strategy_roster.entry_long: (crossabove(ema(close,12), ema(close,26)) and roc(open,2) > 0) or (close > ema(close,26) and close > open and high - low > atr(high,low,close,14))
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,12) - ema(close,26) <= 0.001 * ema(close,26) and ema(close,26) - ema(close,12) <= 0.001 * ema(close,26)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 12/26 EMA pair is used with the two-bar rising-open filter, and the wide-range bullish bar branch uses an ATR-scaled body so the undocumented RangeThreshold/BodyThreshold values are not invented. The documented plus or minus 0.1 percent EMA convergence exit is expressed without a function call, while the midnight daily-EMA filter and absolute price stop targets are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: PROphet
strategy_roster.notes: The custom Qu function is a weighted combination of the last three completed candle ranges, but X1..X4 are given no values, so an equal-weight combination of the three candle bodies is used as the default. The 10:00-18:00 hour window, the coefficient-driven trailing stop and the 18:00 close are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: January Effect
strategy_roster.notes: Entry is a calendar effect that buys near year-end and sells mid-January, so the DSL has no market-derived trigger and none is invented. The documented StopLoss of 2 percent is kept, while the mid-January exit schedule is not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Earnings Announcements With Buybacks
strategy_roster.notes: The documented signal is DaysBefore 5 ahead of an earnings date for companies with an active buyback program, which requires a corporate calendar and fundamental feed absent from the DSL. The DaysAfter 1 exit is equally calendar-based.

strategy_roster.name: Security Free MTF Example
strategy_roster.notes: On the base series donchian_high_prev of one bar is exactly the previous period high, so the documented prior-period high break is a close above it and the short branch becomes the mirrored long exit. The separate per-symbol prior-day request in the sample has no market effect.

strategy_roster.name: VRS Vegas Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close - low >= 0.025 * close and high - close < 0.025 * close
strategy_roster.notes: Spikes are measured from the close as documented, using the default SpikePercent 0.025 for the lower wick and the no-upper-spike condition. The target of twice the spike becomes a 5 percent take-profit and a three-bar 5 percent move as the exit, since the entry price is not available in the DSL.
